notes: Retrospective replay from public historical racecards. Historical source may have been updated after the start; no live pre-race freeze claim.
baseline8 is a SYNTHETIC 8-ticket model assembled from archived fitted weights; NOT the historical actual TK KEIRIN LAB production picks.
Weights trained on Jun-Aug 2026. train is IN SAMPLE. Validation Sep and holdout Oct-Nov were examined in prior research; optimization on those dates needs new future evaluation.
Actual race winner, payout, and line topology are read for scoring ONLY; no labels enter the prediction function.
Outcome-topology group ROI is post-event descriptive, not a feasible pre-race filtering strategy.

definitions.baseline8: Top 8 ordered triples ranked by fitted winner/second/third likelihood (synthetic)
definitions.hybrid8: Top 6 baseline8 plus first 2 unbought cross4 candidate triples
definitions.cross4: Top 2 cross-line ordered pairs x top 2 independently ranked thirds
definitions.cross2full: Top 2 cross-line pairs x all thirds
definitions.cross1full: Top cross-line pair x all thirds
definitions.score4: Score-ranked top 2 cross-line pairs x trained top 2 thirds
